preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for N in test_cases_N)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and -1 <= x <= 100000 for x in B) for B in test_cases_B)
preconditions.description: Each element in B is an integer between -1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The sum of N across all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (len(line.split()) == N and all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in line.split())) for line, N in zip(output_lines, test_cases_N))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' or a sequence of N integers where each integer is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (mex_check(line.split(), B)) for line, B in zip(output_lines, test_cases_B))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the constructed array A satisfies the condition that for every index i where B[i] >= 0, mex(A[0]...A[i]) equals B[i].

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') == (not exists_valid_array(B)) for line, B in zip(output_lines, test_cases_B))
postconditions.description: The output is '-1' if and only if no valid array A exists for the given B.
